title: the image gate takes the pinned engine image by its content, not only by its name (the release bundle's 702 findings)
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the CI image gates' own report of the pinned image (run 45017707606), gated offline on the card's branch, and by the card's tests; the bench's own gates.json was not read.

findings.claim: the D-622 entry (every linux-libc-dev finding of the pinned engine image) matched only a scanned reference whose text ends in the lock's digest, so the pinned content scanned under its tag failed the release gate with 702 findings and make release-bundle refused; it now matches the content's recorded repository digests too, and says plainly when the scan was not of the pinned digest

deploy/measured/serving_config.rtxpro6000.json names the engine image by its tag only (vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0); a VLLM_IMAGE taken from it is a tag, not the lock's tag@digest; that the bench's run took this road is not verified

all 732 fixable High/Critical findings of the pinned engine image (702 linux-libc-dev, 39 of them CRITICAL; 30 others, 3 CRITICAL) are accepted only by standing dated entries that lapse on 2027-01-10; they clear only with a moved pin (a model change, requalify first) or an engine image without the kernel headers
